verdict.rationale: Adyen Issuing is a card-issuing platform with a Customer Area dashboard, so in-product AI-generated insights are a fair question to ask of it. The evidence shows no AI-generated insights or suggestions. Transaction rules, relayed authorisation and card-payment views are manual or rule-based features, and the llms.txt file serves documentation to LLMs rather than producing insights in the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
